name: crosschain-ops-acceptance
description: Critical browser-verifiable behavior for the Cross-Chain Ops template.

assertions.statement: The operations ledger renders useful cross-chain state without a wallet or environment variables.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /operations. Confirm at least three operations are visible, the page is visibly labeled demo mode, and each row shows an operation id, destination chain, and status.

assertions.statement: Operation state is visibly derived from an ordered HCS-shaped event lifecycle.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /operations/demo-complete. Confirm an Ordered HCS events section shows operation.initiated, axelar.observed, destination.executed, and operation.reconciled in ascending sequence order.

assertions.statement: A conflict between recorded destination execution and Axelar evidence is surfaced as a discrepancy.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /operations/demo-discrepancy and confirm the reconciliation result is discrepancy. Also GET /api/reconcile/demo-discrepancy and confirm reconciliation.outcome is discrepancy.

assertions.statement: The JSON API exposes a reusable read model rather than forcing consumers to parse HCS directly.
assertions.howToVerify: GET /api/operations and confirm it returns operation objects with operationId, sourceTxHash, destinationChain, status, lastSequence, and events.

assertions.statement: The repository documents and implements a live Mirror Node path that is activated by HEDERA_TOPIC_ID.
assertions.howToVerify: Inspect packages/nextjs/lib/ops/read-model.ts and mirror.ts. Confirm HEDERA_TOPIC_ID switches from bundled fixtures to public Mirror Node topic pagination and validated payload decoding.
